title: Possessed Woman LOSES Her Mind After Cops Tell Her She’s Trespassing
description:
#news #police #arrest

On January 8th, 2023. Officers were called to a hotel regarding a woman who wouldn't leave the hotel when asked to. After being uncooperative with the officers, they placed her in handcuffs and she started acting erratic and possessed. She also started spiting on officers causing them to put something over her head.
